title: High-throughput screening of FDA-approved drugs identifies colchicine as a potential therapeutic agent for atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumors (AT/RTs)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12331-12341
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01341K, Paper

Colchicine, identified through the screening of 2130 FDA-approved drugs, shows promise as a safe and effective treatment for pediatric AT/RT.
